level_patch.story: One huge convoy blocks the road while bays flicker empty around it.

callout.title: The convoy
callout.body: Research parked one enormous vehicle at the head of the queue — it needs every bay at once, and until they are all free together, nothing moves. Watch the small vehicles pile up behind it, and watch their rings.

callout.title: That feeling has a name
callout.body: Starvation: a job that never gets a turn because a bigger one always blocks it. Fairness of ordering is not enough — you need to book the future, not just serve the present.

callout.title: Place a cone
callout.body: A cone books bays for a future vehicle without occupying them now. Put one on the convoy: pick the vehicle, then its bays. Everything else can see the booking — that is what makes slipping a short vehicle underneath safe.

callout.title: Backfill — the gap you can rent by the hour
callout.body: That short vehicle just parked in the convoy's booked bays and will be gone before the convoy arrives. It has a name in every scheduler manual: backfill. You just did one by hand.

callout.title: A second module
callout.body: The booth can run a second rule now: not only who to serve first, but what to do about the gaps — the place card decides when to reserve and when to backfill. Slot it beside your order card and the booth does your cones for you.

callout.title: Your cards, in text
callout.body: Open the editor: here are the two cards you have been using, written out as exactly what they always were — a kata. Every card you will ever slot is one of these; the editor just lets you see the whole thing. Change anything; Check will tell you what breaks.
